RED_TEXT_SUBTITLE: Show the text of deleted messages in red.
DELETED_MARKER_SUBTITLE: Show “This message was deleted” under deleted messages, with a Dismiss link.
INLINE_EDITS_SUBTITLE: Show earlier versions of an edited message above its current text.
LOG_DELETES_SUBTITLE: Keep deleted messages in the chat.
LOG_EDITS_SUBTITLE: Keep the earlier versions of edited messages.
LOG_DELETED_ATTACHMENTS_SUBTITLE: Keep attachments removed by an edit, marked as deleted.
IGNORE_BOTS_SUBTITLE: Do not log messages sent by bots.
IGNORE_SELF_SUBTITLE: Do not log your own messages.
IGNORE_USERS_SUBTITLE: User IDs whose messages are not logged. Separate IDs with commas or spaces.
IGNORE_CHANNELS_SUBTITLE: Channel or category IDs that are not logged. Separate IDs with commas or spaces.
IGNORE_GUILDS_SUBTITLE: Server IDs that are not logged. Separate IDs with commas or spaces.
LOG_CLEARED: Cleared the log of {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}.
